featured_reviews.name: Lalam Govind
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this store to purchase earrings.

We liked one of the designs, but its hook style was different from what we wanted. They suggested that we reserve the item by paying 30% of the gold amount, and they would order the exact design we preferred. We paid the amount, received an acknowledgment, and left the shop.

After about a week, we received a call from the store informing us that the ornament had arrived. By that time, the gold price had increased by ₹1,800 per gram, but since we had already reserved the item earlier, they honored the previous price, which we really appreciated.

We didn’t check the item thoroughly at first and took it home. After three days, we noticed another issue,, the hangings were attached with flexible rings instead of being soldered, which was not the style we wanted. We visited the store again, and although all similar models had the same design, they kindly agreed to modify ours to a closed hook style as per our request.

The entire process was incredibly smooth, and we were impressed with everythig,, from their hospitality to their collection of designs. Every staff member seemed well-trained.

A special mention to Mr. Ravindra Singh,, he is a true gentleman and knows exactly how to handle customers. I’ll definitely recommend this outlet to my friends for any future purchases.

featured_reviews.name: Anju Gowda
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are ever planning to buy gold scheme, please do not ever join the gold scheme in this place. They pressure you into buying a scheme and when you visit to buy jewelry, they talk as if they are giving away making charges as a favor. The staff they have today don’t have any courtesy at all, lack customer skills, rigid and have such audacity to say buy a coin, making charges is less when asked for making charges discount.

Their calculation is completely wrong, please beware. They claim that they are giving you discount when their calculation itself is wrong. Take out your calculator, you do the math before you agree to anything.

The staff had such insensible conversation and couldn’t calculate the right amount even after going through step by step details and explaining why their number doesn’t tally. He kept saying it’s ok, we will give you for this amount. I am not sure why they are trying to con with miscalculated amount and act as if they are doing a favor when customers are overpaying for making charges. Calculation was not off by thousands but in hundreds. It’s not a lot but every penny matters when you trust someone to sell you gold and you are investing so much.

I am not against Kalyan Jewelers, infact I liked their service and design until this incident. I have shopped in many branded stores and even in Kalyan jewelers in Bangalore. They all have been such great experience but not this place. I would never visit or buy anything from this place ever again.

featured_reviews.name: Kamini Tanawade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing and concerning experience with Anil Jewellers.
I purchased a mangalsutra and a ring that were sold to me as 18-carat hallmarked gold. I was charged higher than the prevailing market rate for both the gold price and the making charges. However, after a few days, I realized that the jewellery given to me was actually KDM gold.
KDM is not the same as BIS Hallmarked gold, and KDM has been discontinued under current government regulations. When I called the shop to question this, they initially tried to convince me that KDM and Hallmark are the same. When I pointed out that they are completely different, they repeatedly denied any wrongdoing. Only after I clearly stated that I would file a legal complaint did they call me back within seconds.
A senior person from the shop then told me not to worry and asked me to bring the jewellery back so they could “engrave” the hallmark on it. When I asked about the mandatory HUID code (which is compulsory under BIS regulations), he then agreed to add that as well. I have recordings of all these conversations.
I returned the jewellery to the shop, and after 2–3 days they gave it back with a hallmark and a 6-digit HUID code. I verified the HUID using the BIS government app.
My personal suggestion to everyone: Don’t buy the gold from Anil jewellers. Please be extremely careful before purchasing gold or jewellery from Anil Jewellers. After this incident, I spoke to several other customers, and many shared similar experiences regarding overcharging and misleading information about gold purity. Always verify the gold rate, making charges, BIS hallmark, and HUID code before making any purchase.
Buyers beware.

featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Saigaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My personal experience at Anil Jewellers was very disappointing. I had purchased a silver bracelet of 3.500 grams (including stones), and on that day the silver rate was around ₹172 per gram. However, they charged me ₹300 per gram by calling it “Italian silver,” which they never proved or explained properly.

When I questioned the pricing, they avoided showing any proper rate chart and kept changing their explanation. They also said that they “have to take margin,” but the margin they applied was extremely high and not transparent at all. Misguiding customers by simply calling something “Italian silver” is not acceptable, especially when selling in a local Mumbai shop where local rates should apply.

The next day when I went to return it, instead of giving a full refund (their bill had no ‘No Refund’ or ‘Exchange Only’ policy mentioned), they deducted ₹200 saying it was because I had “seen the bracelet.” This felt very unfair, as checking a product is a customer’s basic right.

Overall, my experience felt misleading and not customer-friendly. I hope they improve transparency in pricing, avoid confusing customers with terms like “Italian silver,” and treat customers more fairly in the future.  Before buying anything, check the current rate of that day and calculate everything yourself, these people robbed the middle class families by making them fools.

*"Update:
Thank you for the response, but one important issue was not addressed. I want to clarify a few points:

Why was ₹200 deducted during the return? There is no mention of “No Refund” or any deduction policy on my bill.

On what rule or policy is this deduction based?

How can a customer be charged for simply checking a product?

The reason given — “because I saw the bracelet” — is not valid or professional.

₹200 may be a small amount for you, but for someone else it can be a big amount. Transparency and fairness matter.

Please respond to these points, as they were not explained earlier."*
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We truly value every customer and are sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet expectations. At Anil Jewellers, transparency and trust have always been very important to us.

We would like to clarify a few important points regarding 925 Sterling Silver (92.5 silver) jewellery pricing:

✨ Transparent Pricing Explanation

Many customers assume that if silver costs about ₹100 per gram, then with a 10–20% making charge the final price should be ₹120–₹130 per gram.
However, for premium 925 silver jewellery, this is not possible because of several cost factors:

1️⃣ Duty & Import Charges
Around 15–20% extra cost goes only towards duty and taxes, which increases ₹100 to approx. ₹120.

2️⃣ Finishing, Polishing & Rhodium Coating
To make the jewellery durable and shiny, high-quality polishing and rhodium coating are required, which adds significant cost.

3️⃣ Design & Craftsmanship
Premium/Italian finish silver jewellery involves bulk manufacturing, design precision, quality checks, transportation, packaging and wastage — all included in the cost.

✔ Considering all these factors, a good quality 925 silver bracelet or jewellery generally falls around ₹200–₹300 per gram in the market.

But even after that, we always ensure the fairest and most transparent pricing for our customers — no hidden charges.

Regarding Your Experience

If any explanation was unclear , we sincerely apologize. We assure you that we do not believe in confusing or overcharging our customers.

We request you to kindly contact us directly or visit our store so we can resolve this matter personally and ensure your complete satisfaction:

📞 Contact: 7738185684
🏪 Anil Jewellers, Chembur

Thank you for your valuable feedback. It helps us serve our customers even better.

Warm regards,
Team Anil Jewellers

featured_reviews.name: Tabitha Dara
featured_reviews.review_text:
This jeweller charges 1k-2k extra in all products. There is no proper accounting whatsoever. I have attached my receipt for you to calculate and check the way they are duping customers.

Their service is pathetic. Whilst taking an order, the owner is most often not available. And the staff will pass on incorrect or wrong information causing a lot of trouble to innocent customers.

I recently along with a couple other items, had requested for a coral ring to be made. I had specifically mentioned that I wanted a particular size and I wanted to see the gem before the ring was made. The owner didn’t bother to consult. The ring was made as per their understanding. When I wore the ring, I realised the gem is not touching my skin at all. I voiced out my concern, however, the jeweller was really arrogant and kept denying accountability stating that eventually it will touch and that I should have specified that I wanted it to touch my finger. It’s not my fault that they didn’t pay attention while I was placing the order! He then refused to rectify the error and said he would charge me extra for any changes made now.. when I objected, he literally started ignoring me and spoke to his staff treating me like a pariah.

I had to walk out of the shop dejected.

I would seriously not recommend anyone visiting this atrocious place. I found jewellery leaders like Tanishq and BlueStone much better in their customer service and product quality. If one however would like to benefit from purchasing jewellery from local jewellers, Kerala Jewellery Works is definitely not the place to go to. You can explore a plethora of other options other than this shop that is only looting customers.
